name: Redis Server
description: Installs Redis server (8.x by default, from Redis' official APT repo) or its BSD-3 fork Valkey, persists data via a named volume, and starts the daemon on container boot through the shared services dispatcher.

variant.description: Use upstream Redis (AGPLv3) or its drop-in BSD-3 fork Valkey.

password.description: Optional `requirepass`. Empty disables auth (recommended for dev).
